what:
Candidate timbres for a possible voice rebrand, kept so they can be A/B'd in the demo. Each is a licensed synthetic voice speaking one fixed line; the demo clones from it with CosyVoice zero-shot, which is what an actual switch would do.

They exist because the ask was for a named idol's voice, which this project's own rights_note forbids -- a real identifiable person without consent. These belong to nobody. Sofia today measures 6.6% brightness against 10-27% for every one of them, which is the clearest evidence yet that her reference clip was over-denoised.
reference_line: I got the bus going the wrong way on Sunday and ended up at a lake I had never heard of. I stayed an hour because it was beautiful.

pruned.rule: speaker similarity >= 0.70 between reference clips counts as the same voice. Measured because the demo list read as one person: several of these sit at 0.7-0.8 to each other before cloning, and zero-shot cloning converges them further (Emma vs Sonia 0.78 -> 0.81).
